title: Vanishing correlations in stochastic and bistochastic controlled circuits
summary: We study the dynamics of circuits composed of stochastic and bistochastic controlled gates. This type of dynamics arises from quantum circuits with random controlled gates, as well as in stochastic circuits and deterministic classical cellular automata. We prove that stochastic and bistochastic controlled gates lead to two-point spatiotemporal correlation functions that vanish everywhere except when the two operators act on the same site.
